notes:
- **More fixes for the "already in your library" warning when adding a new
  season.** Two cases still got it wrong: a loose file sitting next to a show
  (an OVA, a special, anything the scanner didn't fold into the series) made
  every season of that show look like a duplicate, and correcting the season
  after the warning appeared left the warning on screen even though there was
  nothing to warn about. Fixing the season now clears the notice, and the
  season you already have is what decides it.

---
Windows updates itself on the next launch. Linux updates through your system updater if you installed 2.6.8 or newer; if you are on an older version, download the `.deb` below and install it once more.
